note: Packages whose licence needs a human decision. Each entry says what was decided and why. Written 2026-11-12 from reading package files and metadata; not legal advice. Re-read an entry when its package changes licence or major version.

packages.PyGithub: LGPL: used as an installed library, not modified or bundled.
packages.chardet: LGPL-2.1+: used as an installed library, not modified.
packages.ldap3: LGPL-3: used as an installed library, not modified.
packages.psycopg2-binary: LGPL with the OpenSSL exception: used as an installed library, not modified.
packages.python-gitlab: LGPL-3: used as an installed library, not modified.
packages.urwid: LGPL: pulled in only by mitmproxy's console; not imported by the product.
packages.docutils: Offers BSD among its licences; the BSD option is the one relied on.
packages.text-unidecode: Offers the Artistic licence among its licences; that option is the one relied on. Check before shipping to a customer.
packages.tld: MPL-1.1 OR GPL-2.0 OR LGPL-2.1+: the MPL or LGPL option is the one relied on.
packages.agent-client-protocol: Metadata states no licence; the package's own file is the Apache-2.0 text (read 2026-11-12).
packages.google-crc32c: Metadata states no licence; the package's own file is the Apache-2.0 text (read 2026-11-12).
packages.voyageai: Metadata states no licence; the package's own file is the MIT text (read 2026-11-12).
packages.mitmproxy-rs: Metadata states no licence; the package's own metadata carries the MIT text (read 2026-11-12). Used only by the sandbox-proxy feature.
packages.mitmproxy-linux: No licence text in the package. Built from the same project as mitmproxy-rs (MIT): an inference, not stated by the package. Used only by the sandbox-proxy feature. Confirm with the project before shipping that feature.
packages.tqdm: MPL-2.0 AND MIT: file-level copyleft; used unmodified as an installed library.
packages.certifi: MPL-2.0: file-level copyleft; used unmodified as an installed library.
packages.publicsuffix2: MIT and MPL-2.0: used unmodified as an installed library.
packages.python-dateutil: Dual BSD-3-Clause and Apache-2.0 (its LICENSE file); either is acceptable.
packages.tiktoken: Metadata states no licence; the package's own file is the MIT text (read 2026-11-12).
packages.zulip: Metadata and files state no licence. NOT verified. Used only by the Zulip connector inherited from the upstream project; confirm with the project or remove the connector's dependency before shipping.
